task_definition.task_description: Please search the electronics catalog for headphones and add the black Sony XM5 to my cart. Then, check for trending alternatives for it. From the recommendations, select the silver Sony WH-1000XM5 instead, hold its inventory, and confirm the order. Afterward, create a document titled "Substitute Order Confirmation" with the order details, and finally snapshot the `/workspace/shopping_records` workspace and send me an alert.

user_input.query: Please search the electronics category with the query headphones and add 1 black Sony XM5 (target product ID: p_sony_xm5_blk) to my cart. After that, check for trending alternatives for it. From the recommendations, please select the silver Sony WH-1000XM5 instead, hold its inventory, and confirm the order using my credit_card. My account ID is user_123. Once that's done, create a document titled "Substitute Order Confirmation" with all the order details. Finally, snapshot the /workspace/shopping_records workspace and send me an alert.
